title: upscale x4 (slopcraft)
description: Slopcraft is a base texture pack that has been AI-upscaled locally without using water, mainly for gimmick purposes.
body: SlopCraft is a pack that simply ran the original textures through esrgan. this is mostly a gimick.. i hardly doubt anyone would use this casually. and i dont know why it made the grass white. the AI just did that idk.
